d: Founded in 2006 by the creators of Kali Linux, OffSec (formerly known as Offensive Security) is the leading provider of continuous professional and workforce development, training, and education for cybersecurity practitioners. OffSec’s distinct pedagogy and practical, hands-on learning help organizations fill the infosec talent gap by training their teams on today’s most critical skills.

Become a part of our global presence and work from anywhere. With team members in over 40 countries, we believe in inspiring people of all backgrounds and communities. The OffSec team is composed of diverse, internationally published authors, conference speakers, and seasoned information technology professionals from both the private sector and governments worldwide.
Excited about our mission and what we do? Apply and join us!

CyberSecurity mindset for creative and innovative problem solving

r: OffSec’s robust cybersecurity courses and unique hands-on, realistic skill-based labs, and our highly-coveted industry certifications across a variety of cybersecurity work roles, are increasingly being required or highly preferred by leading enterprises and government agencies around the world. OffSec is committed to helping improve the cybersecurity posture of enterprises, academia, and nations to upskill and develop their workforces with OffSec’s gold standard in professional cybersecurity training.

In this role, you will be responsible for supporting the Academy operations, instructors, students, clients and coordinating the execution of the various components of the overall Academy program. You will be supported cross-functionally to achieve execution.
Teach, mentor and support learners in various OffSec courses, job roles and learning paths
Develop and enhance course curriculum to align with OffSec standards
Assess live training requirements and recommend optimal delivery formats
Conduct live streams, offering real-time guidance and demonstrations on handling lab machines, addressing common challenges, and sharing best practices.
Craft well-researched and informative blog posts on various aspects of cybersecurity.
Participate in sales calls with potential and existing clients, showcasing OffSec Academy’s offerings
Identify resources and prioritize tasks to ensure the success of OffSec Academy’s initiatives
Monitor and report on performance metrics, ensuring teaching programs deliver value and meet goals
Work across teams to communicate, manage expectations, provide escalation management, and balance business needs with technical constraints, all while maintaining a focus on customer experience.
Collaborate with all team members, demonstrating a willingness to help and dive into tasks as needed
